records.complete_norm_class_proof: Put pi=sqrt(2), so (2)=(pi)^2. For primitive r=(x,y), reflection integrality is (q(r))|2I(r), I(r)=(pi*x,G*y). The E8^3 block is even unimodular. Away from (pi), local unimodularity and primitivity make I(r)=O. If x is a unit, q=-pi*x^2 mod pi^2 and v_pi(q)=1. If x is not a unit, some spatial coordinate is a unit, I(r)=O, and evenness gives v_pi(q)>=2; divisibility by 2 forces v_pi(q)=2. Thus the norm ideals are (pi),(pi^2). The unit epsilon=1+pi has signs (+,-), and O*=+/-epsilon^Z, so every totally-positive unit is a square. The totally-positive representatives are epsilon*pi=2+pi and pi^2=2.

first_packet_geometry.exhaustive_argument: In dominant Dynkin weights each E8 factor has z_i>=0 and one highest-root inequality highest.z<=cap*t. Its t=1 section is an 8-simplex. The three inequalities use disjoint blocks, so the whole section is their Cartesian product and its 9^3 vertices exhaust all projective cone rays.

records.scope: Complete primitive mirror-norm classes and exact Vinberg walls through H; hyperideal first-packet rays are not a nonreflectivity proof because later walls may cut them.

records.complete_norm_class_proof: Put pi=sqrt(2), so a=2sqrt(2)=pi^3 and (2)=(pi)^2. For primitive r=(x,y), reflection integrality is (q(r))|2I(r), I(r)=(pi^3*x,G*y). The E8^3 block is even unimodular. Away from (pi), local unimodularity and primitivity make I(r)=O. If some spatial coordinate is a unit, I(r)=O and q is divisible by pi^2; integrality forces v_pi(q)=2. Otherwise x is a unit and y is divisible by pi, so q=-pi^3*x^2 mod pi^4 and v_pi(q)=3. Thus the norm ideals are (pi^2),(pi^3). The unit epsilon=1+pi has signs (+,-), and O*=+/-epsilon^Z, so every totally-positive unit is a square. The totally-positive representatives are pi^2=2 and epsilon*pi^3=4+2pi.
